recipes.description: 自有程序化设置面板，包含标题及纵向内容区域。Procedural settings panel with a title and vertical content.
自有程序化设置分组，包含分组标题和设置行。Procedural titled section for related settings rows.
自有程序化数值设置行，组合标签、滑条和数值文字，适用于音量等有界数值。Procedural labeled slider with a value readout.
自有程序化布尔设置行，组合标签与开关；开关含义由面板方案显式声明。Procedural labeled switch for an explicit boolean setting.
自有程序化枚举设置行，组合标签与下拉菜单，适用于明确的画质档位等有限选项。Procedural labeled select for explicit enumerated settings.
自有程序化只读信息行，组合标签与单行文字，不绑定可变状态，不发出事件。Procedural read-only labeled text for character and summary information.
只读确定进度加载条，由宿主更新连续数值，支持百分比或实际数值显示。Read-only determinate host-owned loading/progress bar.
Horizontal tabs with persistent page state and independent scroll content.
单行文本输入及必填和最短长度校验，支持角色命名、兑换码与搜索。Single-line text/password entry with bounded validation.
Explicit primary visual role. Appearance only; independent of label, action and events.
Explicit secondary visual role. Appearance only; independent of label, action and events.
Explicit danger visual role. Appearance only; independent of label, action and events.
Static content image or labeled placeholder. No state or event.
Checkbox with explicit state and events.
Radio group with explicit state and events.
Selectable list with explicit state and events.
Modal dialog with explicit state and events.
Compact standalone message prose with hidden semantic row label; short prose and the action group are centered, long or multi-paragraph prose stays left-aligned.
